# Getting the SNV signatures

This method returns the available SNV signatures.

## Value

A data frame containing the available SNV signatures.

## Details

The signatures are returned in a data frame containing the available SNV
signatures and the corresponding mutation probability. The first column
("Type") describes a mutation in a context, while each of the remaining
columns contains the probabilities of the mutations for one of the
available SNV signatures.

## See also

`SampleForest$get_indel_signatures()`,
[`MutationEngine`](https://caravagnalab.github.io/ProCESS/1.3/reference/MutationEngine_class.md)

## Examples

# build a mutation engine
m_engine <- MutationEngine(setup_code = "demo")
#>
